prior: Unchanged proper physical box, .5/.5 support-grid level prior and conditioned Bernoulli(.65) support mass; truncated independent Gaussian gain/phase sigma .005. No algorithmic damping as prior.
initialization: Best saved main selection over all three methods by recomputed hierarchical online MAP objective only; no true labels, holdout scores or final error used

optimizer.no_op: Retain saved main start if no paid online trial improves its unchanged data-plus-prior objective
optimizer.preconditioning_scope: Ordinary public box-width preconditioning only; no prior/objective change, clipping, jitter or truth-based tuning

weighted_gradient.gamma_columns: analytic gain/phase derivatives plus unchanged sigma .005 prior

audit.upgrade: same current FE state to full shared J;16 extra transpose RHS
audit.mismatch: raise immediately, retain failure, no offline scoring

holdout.access: All8 online outputs terminal and durable first
holdout.qualification: Previously exposed development re-evaluation, not a new blind test

cost_attribution: Initialization depends on all three paid main arms and their common proposal bank. Retain shared setup/main costs, report actual new costs separately; no matched-cost speedup claim.
